param.bge.method.label: BGE method
param.bge.autobge.num_sample_points.shor: Number of AutoBGE sample points. 0 = auto-calculated from image size (~1 point per 800 downsampled pixels, clamped 200–3000). Higher = denser sampling, slower processing.
param.bge.autobge.poly_degree.label: Poly Degree
param.bge.autobge.poly_degree.short_help: Degree of the first-stage polynomial fit. 2 = quadratic (broad gradients), 3 = cubic (complex gradients). Higher degrees risk overfitting. Recommended: 2.
param.bge.autobge.rbf_smooth.label: RBF Smooth
param.bge.autobge.rbf_smooth.short_help: RBF smoothing factor for the second-stage residual fit. Higher values produce a smoother model and may underfit local gradients. Range: 0–10. Default: 2.0.
param.bge.autobge.downsample_scale.label: Downsample Scale
param.bge.autobge.downsample_scale.short: Downscaling factor for the working image. 4 = 4x downsample (16x fewer pixels). Higher = faster, less spatial resolution. Range 1–8. Recommended: 4.
param.bge.autobge.patch_size.label: Patch Size
param.bge.autobge.patch_size.short_help: Odd patch size for local background sampling. Each sample point measures background in a patch of this size. Range: odd values from 3–101. Default: 35.
param.bge.autobge.patch_estimator.label: Patch Estimator
param.bge.autobge.patch_estimator.short_: Local background estimator. median = fast and robust. sigma_clipped_median = iterative, better for fields with many stars/cosmic rays.
param.bge.autobge.stretch_mode.label: Stretch Mode
param.bge.autobge.stretch_mode.short_hel: Working-space transform for AutoBGE sampling. linear = conservative (preserves additive linearity). mtf = experimental, for AutoBGE parity. Recommended: linear.
Target median for mtf stretch (only when stretch_mode=mtf). Lower values sample darker regions. Range 0.1–0.5.
param.bge.autobge.border_margin.label: Border Margin
param.bge.autobge.border_margin.short_he: Pixel margin excluded from sampling at the image border. Border pixels often contain stacking artifacts. Range: 0–250. Default: 10.
param.bge.autobge.bright_exclusion_fract: Fraction of brightest pixels excluded from sampling. Higher values reject more bright structure. Range: 0.01–0.99. Default: 0.20.
param.bge.autobge.gradient_descent_max_i: Maximum iterations for gradient-descent sample placement. Higher values search farther for dark background positions. Range: 1–500. Default: 100.
param.bge.autobge.random_seed.label: Random Seed
param.bge.autobge.random_seed.short_help: Random seed for deterministic sample-point generation. Same seed + same image = identical results.
param.bge.autobge.normalize_between_stag: When true, normalizes the residual image between polynomial and RBF stages. Prevents RBF from re-fitting gradients already captured by the polynomial. Recommended: true.
param.bge.autobge.apply_guards.label: Apply Guards
param.bge.autobge.apply_guards.short_hel: When true, AutoBGE uses shared BGE apply guards (flatness/slope check) before modifying RGB. Prevents degradation. Recommended: true.
param.bge.autobge.mono_mode.label: Mono Mode
param.bge.autobge.mono_mode.short_help: Handling of mono images. rgb_duplicate copies the channel to R/G/B for per-channel correction. disabled processes only the single channel.
param.bge.autotune.enabled.label: Autotune Enabled
param.bge.autotune.enabled.short_help: When true, BGE runs a deterministic cross-validation search over estimators, quantiles, structure thresholds, and fit methods. Increases runtime, improves quality for difficult fields.
param.bge.autotune.strategy.label: Autotune Strategy
param.bge.autotune.strategy.short_help: conservative = small set of safe parameter combinations (faster). extended = wider search space (slower, better for nebulosity/complex gradients).
param.bge.autotune.max_evals.label: Max Autotune Evals
param.bge.autotune.max_evals.short_help: Hard cap on parameter candidates tested per channel. Each eval fits a full background model. Range 8–64. Recommended: 24 (conservative), 32 (extended).
param.bge.autotune.holdout_fraction.shor: Fraction of sample points reserved for cross-validation (not used for fitting). Range 0.05–0.50. Recommended: 0.20–0.25.
param.bge.autotune.alpha_flatness.label: Flatness Weight α
param.bge.autotune.alpha_flatness.short_: Weight of the flatness term E_flat in the autotune objective J. Higher values prioritize smoother backgrounds. Range 0–1. Recommended: 0.25–0.40 (weak gradients), 0.40–0.80 (strong gradients).
param.bge.autotune.beta_roughness.label: Roughness Weight β
param.bge.autotune.beta_roughness.short_: Weight of the roughness penalty E_rough in the autotune objective J. Higher values penalize bumpy models more. Range 0–0.5. Recommended: 0.08–0.15.
param.bge.tile_weight_lambda_structure.s: Lambda in tile reliability weight w_t=exp(-λ*structure_score_t)*(1-masked_fraction_t). Higher values down-weight structure-rich tiles more aggressively. Range 0.5–3.0. Recommended: 1.0.
param.bge.sample_quantile.label: Sample Quantile
param.bge.sample_quantile.short_help: Tile background quantile for robust estimation. 0.15 = conservative (resistant to nebula contamination). 0.50 = median (for heavily masked fields). Range (0, 0.5].
param.bge.sample_estimator.label: Sample Estimator
param.bge.sample_estimator.short_help: Tile background estimator. quantile uses bge.sample_quantile. sigma_clipped_median, sextractor_mode, biweight = robust pixel estimators.
param.bge.min_sample_bg_value.label: Min Background Value
param.bge.min_sample_bg_value.short_help: Minimum tile background sample value accepted for BGE aggregation. Tiles with lower values are discarded.
param.bge.structure_thresh_percentile.sh: Percentile threshold for rejecting high-structure tiles. Tiles with structure above this percentile are excluded. 0.80 = moderate, 0.90 = strict. Range 0.5–0.95.
param.bge.min_tiles_per_cell.label: Min Tiles/Cell
param.bge.min_tiles_per_cell.short_help: Minimum valid tiles required per BGE grid cell. Cells with fewer tiles trigger insufficient_cell_strategy. Range 1–10. Recommended: 3.
param.bge.min_valid_sample_fraction_for_: Per-channel safety gate. If valid/total samples falls below this fraction, BGE is skipped for that channel. Range 0.1–0.5. Recommended: 0.25–0.30.
param.bge.min_valid_samples_for_apply.sh: Absolute per-channel safety gate. Fewer than this many valid samples → BGE is skipped for that channel. Range 24–200. Recommended: 96.
param.bge.mask.star_dilate_px.label: Star Mask Dilation
param.bge.mask.star_dilate_px.short_help: Star-mask dilation radius in pixels. Expands exclusion zone around stars. Range 0–20. Recommended: 4–6 (normal), 8–12 (wide-field/bright stars).
param.bge.mask.sat_dilate_px.label: Saturation Mask Dilation
param.bge.mask.sat_dilate_px.short_help: Saturation-mask dilation radius in pixels. Expands exclusion zone around saturated pixels. Range 0–20. Recommended: 4–6.
param.bge.grid.N_g.label: Grid Density N_g
param.bge.grid.N_g.short_help: Target grid density. Cell size G = min(W,H) / N_g. Higher = finer grid for better gradient capture. Range 16–64. Recommended: 32–36.
param.bge.grid.G_min_px.label: Min Grid Cell Size
param.bge.grid.G_min_px.short_help: Minimum grid cell size in pixels. Prevents cells from becoming too small on large images. Range 32–128. Recommended: 56–64.
param.bge.grid.G_max_fraction.label: Max Grid Fraction
param.bge.grid.G_max_fraction.short_help: Maximum grid cell size as fraction of min(W,H). Prevents cells from becoming too large on small images. Range 0.1–0.5. Recommended: 0.25.
param.bge.grid.insufficient_cell_strateg: Strategy for grid cells with too few samples. discard = exclude (conservative). nearest = neighbor fill. radius_expand = enlarge search radius. Recommended: radius_expand.
param.bge.fit.method.label: Fit Method
param.bge.fit.method.short_help: Surface fitting method. rbf = Radial Basis Functions (flexible, recommended). poly = robust polynomial (broad gradients, faster). spline = thin-plate spline. modeled_mask_mesh = segmentation-based mesh fit.
param.bge.fit.robust_loss.label: Robust Loss
param.bge.fit.robust_loss.short_help: Robust loss function for IRLS. huber = moderate (quadratic/linear). tukey = aggressive (completely rejects large residuals). Recommended: huber.
param.bge.fit.huber_delta.label: Huber δ
param.bge.fit.huber_delta.short_help: Huber loss transition parameter δ. Residuals < δ quadratic, > δ linear. Smaller δ = more outlier rejection. Range 0.5–3.0. Recommended: 1.5.
param.bge.fit.irls_max_iterations.label: Max IRLS Iterations
param.bge.fit.irls_max_iterations.short_: Maximum IRLS iterations. Higher = better convergence, slower runtime. Range 5–20. Recommended: 10.
param.bge.fit.irls_tolerance.label: IRLS Tolerance
param.bge.fit.irls_tolerance.short_help: Convergence tolerance for IRLS. Stops when parameter change falls below this value. Range 1e-6–1e-3. Recommended: 1e-4.
param.bge.fit.polynomial_order.label: Polynomial Order
param.bge.fit.polynomial_order.short_hel: Polynomial order when method=poly. 2 = quadratic (broad gradients, safe). 3 = cubic (complex asymmetric gradients, higher overfitting risk). Recommended: 2.
param.bge.fit.rbf_phi.label: RBF Kernel
param.bge.fit.rbf_phi.short_help: RBF kernel type. multiquadric = φ(d)=√(d²+μ²) (recommended). thinplate = φ(d)=d²log(d) (scale-invariant). gaussian = φ(d)=exp(-d²/2μ²) (smooth, localized).
param.bge.fit.rbf_mu_factor.label: RBF μ Factor
param.bge.fit.rbf_mu_factor.short_help: RBF shape parameter μ = rbf_mu_factor × G (grid spacing). Controls basis function width. Higher = smoother surfaces. Range 0.5–3.0. Recommended: 1.0–1.5.
param.bge.fit.rbf_lambda.label: RBF Regularization λ
param.bge.fit.rbf_lambda.short_help: RBF regularization parameter λ. Prevents overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. Higher = smoother, may underfit. Range 1e-6–0.1. Recommended: 0.01–0.1.
param.bge.fit.rbf_epsilon.label: RBF Epsilon
param.bge.fit.rbf_epsilon.short_help: Numerical stabilization for thin-plate RBF at d=0. Prevents division by zero. Range 1e-10–1.0. Recommended: 1e-10 (thinplate), 1.0 (multiquadric).

help.workflow.title: Help
help.workflow.subtitle: Workflow help for the standard sequence.
help.workflow.step2.title: Step 1: Scan the input frames
help.workflow.step2.lead: Open Input & Scan or Wizard step 1 and start with a clean intake check.
help.workflow.step2.bullet1: Choose an absolute input directory and run the scan. Only add the path to the run queue with + if you actually want it processed serially.
help.workflow.step2.bullet2: Run the scan and verify that the detected frame count is plausible and that no unexpected files are mixed into the dataset.
help.workflow.step2.bullet3: Verify the detected color mode, image size and, for OSC, the Bayer pattern. Confirm the color mode manually if the dataset is ambiguous.
help.workflow.step2.bullet4: Before starting, review queue order, optional patterns, run labels and, for MONO data, the assigned filters. Without +, the scanned path stays only in the input field.
help.workflow.step3.title: Step 2: Review calibration inputs
help.workflow.step3.lead: Bias, dark and flat are only needed if the light frames are not already calibrated.
help.workflow.step3.bullet1: Enable bias, dark and flat only for the components your dataset actually needs.
help.workflow.step3.bullet2: Depending on your setup, choose either a directory with raw calibration frames or a master calibration file directly.
help.workflow.step3.bullet3: Keep the switches disabled if the lights are already calibrated or if you intentionally calibrated outside the pipeline.
help.workflow.step3.bullet4: Use readable absolute paths and make sure the filter and exposure logic matches your light frames.
help.workflow.step4.title: Step 3: Adjust and validate parameters
help.workflow.step4.lead: Parameter Studio is the central place for presets, fine tuning and the final technical review.
help.workflow.step4.bullet1: Start from a matching preset or from the current configuration and adjust parameters section by section.
help.workflow.step4.bullet2: Use search and the Explain panel to quickly understand effect, value range and risk of a setting.
help.workflow.step4.bullet3: For difficult datasets, pay special attention to registration, runtime limits and the BGE/PCC parameters.
help.workflow.step4.bullet4: Always run validation before starting. Errors should block the run; warnings should only remain if you accept them deliberately.
help.workflow.step5.title: Step 4: Start a run
help.workflow.step5.lead: A run can be launched from Dashboard, Wizard or the dedicated start controls.
help.workflow.step5.bullet1: Set output folder and run name so the result directory can later be clearly mapped to the dataset.
help.workflow.step5.bullet2: Check guardrails and validation status before starting. A red state should be resolved before launch.
help.workflow.step5.bullet3: Start the run and then move to Run Monitor to track phases, logs, stats, artifacts and resume targets.
help.workflow.step6.title: Step 6: Review outputs and report
help.workflow.step6.lead: Once all phases are complete, the output directory contains the generated files, intermediate results and the optional report.
help.workflow.step6.bullet1: Typical top-level results are files such as stack*, solve*, bge* or pcc*. They represent the stacked result, plate-solve/WCS outputs, background correction and color calibration.
help.workflow.step6.bullet2: The outputs subfolder usually contains the actual image products of the pipeline. That is where you find the final or near-final FITS files for the key processing stages.
help.workflow.step6.bullet3: The artifacts subfolder contains diagnostics and side products such as logs, statistics, JSON summaries and, if you generate it, the HTML report. If you want a report, generate it after the run; it will then appear in the artifacts folder.
help.workflow.step6.bullet4: registered and similar subfolders may contain registered intermediates, debug outputs or derived intermediate products, depending on configuration. These files are mainly useful for analysis, comparison and troubleshooting.
help.workflow.step6.bullet5: If you only want to assess the final result, start with the final stack/solve/BGE/PCC files. If you want to understand why the result turned out good or bad, also work through artifacts, logs and the report.

param.astrometry.astap_data_dir.label: ASTAP Data Dir
param.astrometry.astap_data_dir.short_he: Path to ASTAP data directory (empty = default path). Default: /media/data/Astro/astap.
param.astrometry.enabled.label: Enabled
param.astrometry.search_radius.label: Search Radius
param.astrometry.search_radius.short_hel: Search radius in degrees (180 = blind solve). Range: >= 1, <= 360. Default: 183.
param.calibration.bias_dir.short_help: Input directories for calibration stacks. Default: .
param.calibration.bias_master.label: Bias Master
param.calibration.bias_master.short_help: Paths to precomputed master calibration files. Default: .
param.calibration.bias_use_master.label: Bias Use Master
param.calibration.bias_use_master.short_: Use prebuilt master calibration files instead of stacking directories. Default: false.
param.calibration.dark_auto_select.label: Dark Auto Select
param.calibration.dark_auto_select.short: Auto-select matching darks by exposure (and optionally temperature). Default: true.
param.calibration.dark_master.label: Dark Master
param.calibration.dark_master.short_help: Paths to precomputed master calibration files. Default: .
param.calibration.dark_match_exposure_to: Maximum exposure time deviation for dark matching, in percent. Darks outside ±tolerance% are excluded. Range: >= 0. Default: 8.
param.calibration.dark_match_temp_tolera: Temperature tolerance for dark matching in °C. Only used when dark_match_use_temp=true. Range: >= 0. Default: 3.
param.calibration.dark_match_use_temp.sh: When true, also match darks by sensor temperature within dark_match_temp_tolerance_c. Default: false.
param.calibration.dark_already_bias_corr: Set true only when the configured master dark already has the bias pedestal removed. Default: false.
param.calibration.dark_use_master.label: Dark Use Master
param.calibration.dark_use_master.short_: Use prebuilt master calibration files instead of stacking directories. Default: false.
param.calibration.darks_dir.short_help: Input directories for calibration stacks. Default: .
param.calibration.flat_master.label: Flat Master
param.calibration.flat_master.short_help: Paths to precomputed master calibration files. Default: .
param.calibration.flat_use_master.label: Flat Use Master
param.calibration.flat_use_master.short_: Use prebuilt master calibration files instead of stacking directories. Default: false.
param.calibration.flats_dir.short_help: Input directories for calibration stacks. Default: .
param.calibration.pattern.label: Pattern
param.calibration.use_bias.short_help: Enable bias-frame calibration. When true, a master bias is created from bias_dir or loaded from bias_master. Default: false.
param.calibration.use_dark.short_help: Enable dark-frame calibration. When true, a master dark is created from darks_dir or loaded from dark_master. Default: false.
param.calibration.use_flat.short_help: Enable flat-field calibration. When true, a master flat is created from flats_dir or loaded from flat_master. Default: false.
param.chroma_denoise.apply_stage.label: Apply Stage
param.chroma_denoise.apply_stage.short_h: Allowed values: post_stack_linear, post_pcc. Default: post_pcc.
param.chroma_denoise.blend.amount.label: Amount
param.chroma_denoise.blend.amount.short_: Blend amount between original and denoised chroma. 0 = no denoise, 1 = full denoise. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.85.
param.chroma_denoise.blend.mode.label: Mode
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_bilateral.en: Enable bilateral filter for chroma denoise. Edge-preserving smoothing of color channels. Default: true.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_bilateral.si: Range-sigma multiplier relative to measured background chroma noise. Default: 2.0.
Spatial sigma for bilateral filter. Controls the spatial extent of smoothing. Range: > 0. Default: 1.2.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.enab: Enable wavelet-based chroma denoise. Decomposes chroma into wavelet levels and thresholds noise. Default: true.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.leve: Number of wavelet decomposition levels. More levels capture larger-scale noise. Range: >= 1. Default: 3.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.soft: Soft-thresholding parameter k. Controls smoothness of threshold transition. Higher = smoother. Range: > 0. Default: 1.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.thre: Scale factor for wavelet noise threshold. Higher values remove more color noise. Range: > 0. Default: 1.25.
param.chroma_denoise.color_space.label: Color Space
param.chroma_denoise.color_space.short_h: Allowed values: ycbcr_linear, opponent_linear. Default: ycbcr_linear.
param.chroma_denoise.enabled.label: Enabled
param.chroma_denoise.enabled.short_help: Enable chroma (color) noise denoise. Removes color noise blotches while preserving luma detail. Default: false (opt-in).
param.chroma_denoise.luma_guard_strength: Strength of luma protection guard. 0 = no protection, 1 = full protection. Higher values prevent any luma modification. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.75.
param.chroma_denoise.protect_luma.label: Enable Protection Masks
param.chroma_denoise.protect_luma.short_: Enables the star, structure and extended-source protection masks. Chroma denoise always preserves linear luma. Default: true.
param.chroma_denoise.star_protection.dil: Dilation radius for star protection mask in pixels. Expands protection zone around stars. Range: >= 0. Default: 2.
param.chroma_denoise.star_protection.ena: Enable star protection mask for chroma denoise. Prevents color noise removal from degrading star colors. Default: true.
param.chroma_denoise.star_protection.thr: Sigma threshold for star detection in protection mask. Lower values detect more stars. Range: > 0. Default: 2.2.
param.chroma_denoise.structure_protectio: Enable structure protection for chroma denoise. Prevents denoise from blurring nebula edges and galaxy arms. Default: true.
Gradient percentile threshold for structure protection. Regions with gradient above this percentile are protected. Range: >= 0, <= 100. Default: 85.
param.luma_denoise.enabled.label: Enabled
param.luma_denoise.enabled.short_help: Enable standalone luminance denoise, running on the reconstructed post-stack linear image before BGE/PCC. Default: false.
param.luma_denoise.luma_guard_strength.s: Strength of the guard protecting luminance structure from over-smoothing. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.85.
param.luma_denoise.blend_amount.label: Blend Amount
param.luma_denoise.blend_amount.short_he: Blend amount between original and denoised luma. 0 = no denoise, 1 = full denoise. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.85.
param.luma_denoise.star_protection.enabl: Enable star protection mask so denoise doesn't soften star cores/halos. Default: true.
param.luma_denoise.star_protection.thres: Sigma threshold for star detection in the protection mask. Range: > 0. Default: 6.
param.luma_denoise.star_protection.dilat: Dilation radius for the star protection mask in pixels. Range: >= 0. Default: 8.
Enable structure protection so denoise doesn't blur fine, faint detail (e.g. nebula structure). Default: true.
Gradient percentile threshold for structure protection. Regions with gradient above this percentile are protected. Range: >= 0, <= 100. Default: 90.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.enabled.label: Enabled
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.enabled.short: Enable wavelet-based luma denoise. Decomposes luma into wavelet levels and soft-thresholds noise. Default: true.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.levels.label: Levels
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.levels.short_: Number of wavelet decomposition levels. More levels capture larger-scale noise. Range: >= 1. Default: 3.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.threshold_sca: Scale factor for the wavelet noise threshold. Higher values remove more luma noise. Range: > 0. Default: 1.5.
param.luma_denoise.extended_source_prote: Protects diffuse nebulae/large galaxies from luma denoising. Default: false.
Detection threshold above sky background, in sigma units. Range: 1-5. Default: 2.5.
Dilation radius after detection, to cover PSF halos. Default: 30.
param.luma_denoise.bilateral.enabled.sho: Enable bilateral filter after the wavelet stage. Addresses background noise the wavelet stage structurally cannot remove. Default: false.
param.luma_denoise.bilateral.sigma_spati: Spatial sigma for bilateral filter. Range: > 0. Default: 1.5.
param.luma_denoise.bilateral.sigma_range: Multiplier relative to the measured background luma sigma. Range: > 0. Default: 2.0.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.soft_k.label: Soft K
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.soft_k.short_: Soft-thresholding parameter k. Controls smoothness of threshold transition. Higher = smoother. Range: > 0. Default: 1.
param.data.bayer_pattern.short_help: Bayer matrix pattern for color filter arrays. NONE for monochrome data.
param.data.color_mode.label: Color Mode
param.data.color_mode.short_help: Expected camera color mode. Allowed values: OSC, MONO, RGB.
param.data.image_height.label: Image Height
param.data.image_height.short_help: Optional expected image height in pixels. Range: >= 0.
param.data.image_width.label: Image Width
param.data.image_width.short_help: Optional expected image width in pixels. Range: >= 0.
param.dithering.enabled.label: Enabled
param.dithering.enabled.short_help: Mark session as dithered. Enables dither diagnostics (detected_count/fraction) in global_registration.json. Default: true.
param.dithering.min_shift_px.label: Min Shift PX
param.dithering.min_shift_px.short_help: Minimum shift in pixels to count a frame as dithered. Range: >= 0. Default: 0.7.
param.global_metrics.adaptive_weights.sh: Auto-adjust global metric weights by variance. Default: true.
param.global_metrics.clamp.label: Clamp
param.global_metrics.clamp.short_help: Clamp range before exponential weighting. Default: [-3, 3].
param.global_metrics.weight_exponent_sca: Exponential scaling factor for global weight separation. Range: > 0. Default: 1.2.
Weight for low background in the global frame weight. All global_metrics.weights.* must sum to 1.0. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.45.
param.global_metrics.weights.fwhm.label: FWHM
param.global_metrics.weights.fwhm.short_: Weight for star sharpness in the global frame weight. Lower FWHM is preferred. All global_metrics.weights.* must sum to 1.0. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.
param.global_metrics.weights.gradient.sh: Weight for the gradient metric in the global frame weight. All global_metrics.weights.* must sum to 1.0. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.25.
param.global_metrics.weights.noise.label: Noise
param.global_metrics.weights.noise.short: Weight for low noise in the global frame weight. All global_metrics.weights.* must sum to 1.0. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.3.
param.global_metrics.weights.roundness.s: Weight for round stars in the global frame weight. Values near 1.0 are preferred. All global_metrics.weights.* must sum to 1.0. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.
Weight for the number of valid measured stars in the global frame weight. More stars are preferred. All global_metrics.weights.* must sum to 1.0. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.
param.linearity.enabled.label: Enabled
param.linearity.max_frames.label: Max Frames
param.linearity.max_frames.short_help: Number of frames used for linearity diagnostics. Range: >= 1. Default: 8.
param.linearity.min_overall_linearity.sh: Minimum acceptable global linearity score. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.9.
param.linearity.strictness.label: Strictness
param.linearity.strictness.short_help: Controls whether linearity violations fail, warn, or are ignored. Allowed values: strict, moderate, permissive. Default: moderate.
param.normalization.enabled.label: Enabled
param.normalization.mode.label: Mode
param.normalization.mode.short_help: Normalization method. background: robust background matching (recommended). none: disabled (not recommended for production). Allowed values: background, median. Default: background.
param.normalization.per_channel.label: Per Channel
param.normalization.per_channel.short_he: Normalize channels independently for OSC/RGB data. Default: true.
param.output.crop_to_nonzero_bbox.label: Crop To Nonzero Bbox
param.output.crop_to_nonzero_bbox.short_: Crop final stack to bounding box of all non-zero pixels. true: Removes empty borders from final image. Only pixels with values > 0 are kept. Reduces file size and removes unnecessary black borders. false: Keeps full canvas size, including empty borders. Applied after stacking phase but before debayer (for OSC). Tile offsets are adjusted accordingly. Default: true.
param.output.registered_dir.label: Registered Dir
param.output.registered_dir.short_help: Subdirectory for registered frames (under runs/<run_id>/outputs/). Default: registered.
param.output.write_registered_frames.sho: Persist registered frames as FITS (reg_XXXXX.fit). Default: true.
param.pcc.annulus_inner_fwhm_mult.label: Annulus Inner FWHM Mult
param.pcc.annulus_inner_fwhm_mult.short_: Conservative FWHM-adaptive radius controls (v3.3.6 §6.4.2). Range: > 0. Default: 3.
param.pcc.annulus_inner_px.label: Annulus Inner PX
param.pcc.annulus_inner_px.short_help: Inner radius of the sky annulus in pixels for PCC photometry. Used when radii_mode=fixed. Range: > 0. Default: 10.
param.pcc.annulus_outer_fwhm_mult.label: Annulus Outer FWHM Mult
param.pcc.annulus_outer_fwhm_mult.short_: Conservative FWHM-adaptive radius controls (v3.3.6 §6.4.2). Range: > 0. Default: 5.
param.pcc.annulus_outer_px.label: Annulus Outer PX
param.pcc.annulus_outer_px.short_help: Outer radius of the sky annulus in pixels for PCC photometry. Used when radii_mode=fixed. Range: > 0. Default: 16.
param.pcc.aperture_fwhm_mult.label: Aperture FWHM Mult
param.pcc.aperture_fwhm_mult.short_help: Conservative FWHM-adaptive radius controls (v3.3.6 §6.4.2). Range: > 0. Default: 1.8.
param.pcc.aperture_radius_px.label: Aperture Radius PX
param.pcc.aperture_radius_px.short_help: Fixed aperture radius in pixels for PCC photometry. Used when radii_mode=fixed. Range: > 0. Default: 8.
param.pcc.apply_attenuation.label: Apply Attenuation
param.pcc.apply_attenuation.short_help: Enables adaptive attenuation during PCC matrix application (helps in deep shadows/highlights). Default: false.
param.pcc.background_model.label: Background Model
param.pcc.background_model.short_help: Local sky-annulus background model for stellar photometry (plane recommended under gradients, fallback to median if plane fit fails). Allowed values: median, plane. Default: plane.
param.pcc.chroma_strength.label: Chroma Strength
param.pcc.chroma_strength.short_help: Global strength factor for PCC chroma correction during apply. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.85.
param.pcc.enabled.label: Enabled
param.pcc.enabled.short_help: Enable Photometric Color Calibration (PCC). Matches catalog star colors to calibrate the RGB color balance of the stacked image. Default: true.
param.pcc.mag_bright_limit.label: Mag Bright Limit
param.pcc.mag_bright_limit.short_help: Bright magnitude limit for PCC catalog star matching. Stars brighter than this are excluded (saturated stars give unreliable photometry). Range: >= 0, <= 15. Default: 6.
param.pcc.mag_limit.label: Mag Limit
param.pcc.mag_limit.short_help: Faint magnitude limit for PCC catalog star matching. Higher values include fainter stars. CAUTION: for small sensors or dense star fields, mag_limit > 15 can include stars below detection threshold. Range: >= 1, <= 22. Default: 14.
param.pcc.max_condition_number.label: Max Condition Number
param.pcc.max_condition_number.short_hel: Upper bound for PCC matrix condition number; rejects numerically unstable solutions. Range: >= 1. Default: 3.
param.pcc.max_residual_rms.label: Max Residual RMS
param.pcc.max_residual_rms.short_help: Upper bound for robust fit residual RMS; rejects noisy/unstable PCC fits. Range: > 0. Default: 0.7.
param.pcc.min_aperture_px.label: Min Aperture PX
param.pcc.min_aperture_px.short_help: Conservative FWHM-adaptive radius controls (v3.3.6 §6.4.2). Range: > 0. Default: 4.
param.pcc.min_stars.label: Min Stars
param.pcc.min_stars.short_help: Minimum number of matched catalog stars required for PCC to proceed. Below this, PCC is skipped. Range: >= 3. Default: 10.
param.pcc.radii_mode.label: Radii Mode
param.pcc.radii_mode.short_help: Radius handling mode. auto_fwhm derives aperture/annulus radii from seeing FWHM using the multipliers below. Allowed values: fixed, auto_fwhm. Default: auto_fwhm.
param.pcc.sigma_clip.short_help: Sigma clipping threshold for PCC outlier rejection. Stars with residuals > sigma_clip × std are rejected. Range: > 0. Default: 2.5.
param.pcc.siril_catalog_dir.label: Siril Catalog Dir
param.pcc.siril_catalog_dir.short_help: Optional local Siril catalog path. Default: .
param.pcc.source.short_help: Source catalog/provider for PCC. Allowed values: auto, siril, vizier_gaia, vizier_apass. Default: siril.
param.registration.enable_star_pair_fall: Enable/disable the extra Star-Pairs fallback stage between Triangle Stars and Trail Endpoints. Set to false to disable the Star-Pairs stage for a stricter fallback policy. When direct registration i→ref fails, the runner automatically tries:. When fewer than star_topk / 2 stars are detected, a second detection pass with a lower threshold (2.5σ instead of 3.5σ) is automatically performed. Default: false.
param.registration.engine.short_help: Primary registration engine. The runner always runs a 6-stage fallback cascade; this key selects the preferred first stage. Allowed values: triangle_star_matching, star_similarity, hybrid_phase_ecc, robust_phase_ecc. Default: triangle_star_matching.
param.registration.reject_cc_min_abs.sho: Absolute minimum correlation-coefficient threshold in registration outlier rejection. Lower values keep more borderline but often usable edge frames. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.25.
param.registration.reject_outliers.label: Reject Outliers
param.registration.reject_outliers.short: Enable robust post-checks for implausible global warps. Default: true.
param.registration.reject_scale_max.shor: Allowed similarity scale range. Warps outside [reject_scale_min, reject_scale_max] or with negative determinant (reflection) are rejected. Range: > 0. Default: 1.08.
param.registration.reject_scale_min.shor: Allowed similarity scale range. Warps outside [reject_scale_min, reject_scale_max] or with negative determinant (reflection) are rejected. Range: > 0. Default: 0.92.
param.registration.reject_shift_median_m: Multiplier for robust shift threshold (multiplier * median_shift). Range: > 0. Default: 5.
param.registration.reject_shift_px_min.s: Fixed minimum shift threshold for rejection logic. Range: >= 0. Default: 100.
param.registration.star_dist_bin_px.shor: Distance histogram bin size in star_similarity. Range: > 0. Default: 5.
param.registration.star_inlier_tol_px.sh: Inlier tolerance in pixels for transformed star matches. Range: > 0. Default: 4.
param.registration.star_min_inliers.shor: Minimum inlier matches required for acceptance. Range: >= 2. Default: 4.
param.registration.star_topk.short_help: Number of strongest stars used for star-based matching. Range: >= 3. Default: 150.
param.registration.blind_chain_drift_thr: Maximum allowed drift in pixels per frame within a blind chain. Chain aborts if exceeded. Range: 0.5 - 10.0. Default: 2.0.
param.registration.blind_chain_strong_an: CC threshold for 'strong anchors' in blind chains. Frames with higher CC can start deeper chains. Range: 0.01 - 0.5. Default: 0.08.
param.registration.enable_local_backgrou: Enable local background subtraction before star detection. Helpful with moonlight or strong gradients. Range: true/false. Default: false.
param.registration.max_blind_chain_depth: Maximum depth for blind-chain rescue. 0 = auto (N/10, min 12, max 50). >0 = manual override. Range: 0 - 100. Default: 0.
param.registration.use_astrometry.label: Use Astrometry
param.registration.use_astrometry.short_: Enable astrometric rescue for frames that fail all other registration algorithms. Requires ASTAP binary and catalog in astrometry.*. Range: true/false. Default: true.
Search radius for the shift-consistency filter in triangle_star_matching (px on proxy image). Must cover the maximum expected inter-frame shift. Equatorial mount: 60, Alt/Az mount (e.g. DWARF II, multi-hour session): 200-400. Range: 10-2000. Default: 200.
param.runtime_limits.hard_abort_hours.sh: Hard upper runtime limit in hours. Range: > 0. Default: 6.
param.runtime_limits.memory_budget.label: Memory Budget
param.runtime_limits.memory_budget.short: Memory cap that can reduce effective worker parallelism (especially for OSC). Range: >= 1. Default: 2048.
param.runtime_limits.parallel_workers.sh: Max worker threads for tile-heavy phases. Range: >= 1. Default: 8.
param.stacking.per_frame_cosmetic_correc: Hot-pixel correction per frame before PREWARP/stacking. This targets fixed sensor defects (RGB single-pixel speckles) that appear at the same coordinates in every frame and therefore can survive stack sigma clipping. Default: true.
MAD-sigma threshold for stacking.per_frame_cosmetic_correction. Range: > 0. Default: 2.5.
param.hypermetric_stretch.enabled.label: Enabled
param.hypermetric_stretch.enabled.short_: Enables HyperMetric Stretch processing for output. When disabled, no stretch is applied. Default: true.
param.hypermetric_stretch.adaptive_ancho: When true, the anchor point for the stretch is determined adaptively from the image. When false, a fixed anchor is used. Default: true.
param.hypermetric_stretch.color_grip.sho: Controls how strongly the original color ratios are preserved. 1 preserves colors more strongly; lower values move channels toward their individual stretch. Range: 0.0–1.0. Default: 1.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.color_strategy: Color strategy: 'auto' (automatic selection) or 'fixed' (fixed value from fixed_color_strategy). Default: fixed.
param.hypermetric_stretch.convergence_po: Controls how quickly color channels converge in brighter regions. Higher values preserve color differences farther into the midtones. Range: 1.0–10.0. Default: 3.5.
param.hypermetric_stretch.fallback_profi: Fallback sensor profile when the primary profile is unavailable. Default: rec709.
param.hypermetric_stretch.fixed_color_st: Fixed color strategy value [-1,1], used when color_strategy='fixed'. 0 = neutral, positive = warmer colors, negative = cooler. Default: 0.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.fixed_log_d.sh: Fixed logarithmic stretch strength used in Fixed log-D mode. Higher values brighten faint structures more strongly. Range: 0.0–7.0. Default: 2.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.color_cast_cor: Adaptive average-neutral green-cast correction after HMS; default: off.
Upper limit of the automatically chosen strength (0–1]; default: 1.0.
Median G/((R+B)/2) on object pixels that the correction aims for; 1.0 = neutral; default: 1.0.
If the measured green ratio is at or below this value nothing is changed; default: 1.02.
Object pixels are those clearly above the sky (in sky sigmas); default: 3.
Number of equal-count brightness classes; the strength is chosen per class; 1 = one global strength; default: 8.
Also shift the green channel so that the sky itself is neutral; default: off.
param.hypermetric_stretch.highlight_ceil: Percentile used as the highlight ceiling instead of the true brightest pixel. 100 (default) never clips, which on a target with one very bright, compact highlight (e.g. a nebula core) can cap contrast for the whole frame. Lower (e.g. 99.9) trades a small, bounded amount of clipping for more contrast in stars/highlights. Only affects the top ~1-2% of tones; raise target_bg too if the dark/mid-tone body should also be brighter. Range: 90–100. Default: 100.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.linear_expansi: Linear expansion at the lower end of the stretch curve. Increases detail in very dark regions. Range: >= 0. Default: 0.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.log_d_mode.sho: log-D mode: 'auto' (determined from image statistics) or 'fixed' (uses fixed_log_d). Default: auto.
param.hypermetric_stretch.mode.short_hel: Stretch mode: 'ready_to_use' (ready for display) or 'scientific' (linear preserved for scientific purposes). Default: ready_to_use.
param.hypermetric_stretch.output_rgb.sho: Filename for the HyperMetric Stretch RGB output file. Default: stacked_rgb_hms.fits.
param.hypermetric_stretch.protect_b.shor: Shapes the hyperbolic curve to protect bright regions. Higher values compress highlights more strongly. Range: 0.1–15.0. Default: 6.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.require_succes: When true, the stretch is only applied if PCC was successful. When false, the stretch is applied without PCC. Default: true.
param.hypermetric_stretch.sensor_profile: Sensor profile for color processing: 'rec709' (default), profile name, or 'auto'. Default: rec709.
param.hypermetric_stretch.shadow_converg: Blends more strongly toward per-channel stretching in dark regions. Higher values restrict the effect to deeper shadows. Range: 0.0–3.0. Default: 0.0.
param.hypermetric_stretch.target_bg.shor: Desired background brightness after stretching. Higher values produce a brighter background. Range: 0.05–0.50. Default: 0.15.
param.hypermetric_stretch.write_channels: When true, individual channels (R/G/B) are written in addition to the RGB output. Default: false.
param.pcc.background_neutralization_mode: Background neutralization mode: 'always' (always), 'auto' (automatic based on star count and fit quality), or 'off' (disabled). Default: auto.
param.registration.auto_engine.label: Auto Engine
param.registration.auto_engine.short_hel: When true, probes a few frames before registration and overrides the engine to triangle_star_matching+affine when strong field rotation is detected (Alt/Az mount). Default: true.
param.registration.auto_engine_rotation_: Rotation per frame in degrees above which auto_engine triggers the override. Default: 0.05 (triggers at ~0.6 deg/min for 5s exposures).
param.runtime_limits.acceleration_backen: Acceleration backend for PREWARP and FORWARD_DRIZZLE computations. 'auto' detects available GPU backends at runtime and falls back to CPU cleanly. Default: auto.

param.bge.method.short_help: Selects the background gradient extraction method: none, classic, or autobge.
param.bge.method.explain: Controls the background gradient extraction method. 'none' disables BGE. 'classic' uses the grid-based classic model. 'autobge' uses the two-stage automatic search with polynomial and RBF fitting.
param.bge.autobge.exclusion_polygons.sho: List of manual exclusion regions for AutoBGE sampling.
param.bge.autobge.user_sample_points.sho: List of manual background sample points for AutoBGE.
param.output.crop_to_nonzero_bbox.explai: Crop final stack to bounding box of all non-zero pixels.
param.data.image_width.explain: Optional expected image width in pixels.
param.data.image_height.explain: Optional expected image height in pixels.
param.data.bayer_pattern.explain: Bayer matrix pattern for color filter arrays. `NONE` for monochrome data, `auto` to derive the pattern from the FITS header.
param.linearity.max_frames.explain: Number of frames used for linearity diagnostics.
param.linearity.strictness.explain: Controls whether linearity violations fail, warn, or are ignored.
param.calibration.dark_already_bias_corr: Marks a master dark as already bias-corrected. When `false` and `use_bias: true`, the runner subtracts the bias from the dark internally before applying calibration so the light-frame offset is not removed twice.
param.calibration.dark_auto_select.expla: Auto-select matching darks by exposure (and optionally temperature).
param.calibration.dark_match_exposure_to: Maximum allowed exposure mismatch for dark matching in percent.
param.calibration.pattern.explain: Glob pattern used for calibration file discovery.
param.normalization.per_channel.explain: Normalize channels independently for OSC/RGB data.
param.registration.engine.explain: Primary registration engine. The runner always runs a **6-stage fallback cascade**; this key selects the preferred first stage.
param.registration.enable_star_pair_fall: Enable/disable the extra Star-Pairs fallback stage between Triangle Stars and Trail Endpoints.
param.registration.allow_rotation.explai: Allow rotation in global registration (required for Alt/Az).
param.registration.star_topk.explain: Number of strongest stars used for star-based matching.
param.registration.star_min_inliers.expl: Minimum inlier matches required for acceptance.
param.registration.star_inlier_tol_px.ex: Inlier tolerance in pixels for transformed star matches.
param.registration.reject_outliers.expla: Enable robust post-checks for implausible global warps.
param.registration.reject_shift_px_min.e: Fixed minimum shift threshold for rejection logic.
param.registration.reject_shift_median_m: Multiplier for robust shift threshold (`multiplier * median_shift`).
param.registration.max_blind_chain_depth: Maximum depth for blind-chain rescue. `0` = automatic (N/10, min 12, max 50).
param.registration.blind_chain_strong_an: CC threshold for "strong anchors" in blind chains. Frames with higher CC can start deeper chains.
param.registration.blind_chain_drift_thr: Maximum allowed drift in pixels per frame within a blind chain.
param.registration.use_astrometry.explai: Enable astrometric rescue for frames that fail all other registration algorithms.
param.registration.enable_local_backgrou: Enable local background subtraction before star detection.
Search radius for the shift-consistency filter in `triangle_star_matching` (pixels on the proxy image at half resolution). After triangle voting, each star pair is checked against others to find how many imply a similar shift (within this radius). The cluster with the highest support becomes the anchor; all inconsistent pairs are discarded. The radius must cover the **maximum expected inter-frame shift**.
param.dithering.enabled.explain: Mark session as dithered. Enables dither diagnostics (`detected_count`/`fraction`) in `global_registration.json`.
param.dithering.min_shift_px.explain: Minimum shift in pixels to count a frame as dithered.
param.chroma_denoise.enabled.explain: Enable chroma (color) noise denoise. Removes color noise blotches while preserving luma detail. Recommended for OSC data. Default: off (opt-in).
param.chroma_denoise.color_space.explain: Linear invertible chroma transform. `ycbcr_linear` is the project-specific Y=0.25R+0.5G+0.25B transform, not a Rec.601/Rec.709 encoding; `opponent_linear` uses channel differences around the arithmetic mean.
param.chroma_denoise.apply_stage.explain: Single stage at which chroma denoise is applied. `post_stack_linear` runs before BGE and PCC; `post_pcc` runs after color calibration and is the default.
param.chroma_denoise.protect_luma.explai: Enables luma-derived protection masks that preserve stars, structure and extended sources; linear luma itself is always unchanged.
param.chroma_denoise.luma_guard_strength: Strength of luma protection guard. 0 = no protection, 1 = full protection. Higher values prevent any luma modification from chroma denoise side effects.
param.chroma_denoise.blend.mode.explain: Blending mode between original and denoised image. Currently only `chroma_only` is supported.
param.chroma_denoise.blend.amount.explai: Blend fraction between original and denoised chroma. 0 = no denoise, 1 = full denoise. Range 0–1. Recommended: 0.90–0.95.
param.chroma_denoise.star_protection.ena: Enable star protection mask for chroma denoise. Prevents color noise removal from degrading star colors and halos.
param.chroma_denoise.star_protection.thr: Sigma threshold for star detection in protection mask. Lower values detect more stars (more aggressive protection). Range > 0. Recommended: 2.5–3.5.
param.chroma_denoise.star_protection.dil: Dilation radius for star protection mask in pixels. Expands the protection zone around detected stars to cover halos. Range >= 0. Recommended: 2–4.
param.chroma_denoise.structure_protectio: Enable structure protection for chroma denoise. Prevents denoise from blurring nebula edges, galaxy arms, and other fine structures.
Gradient percentile threshold for structure protection. Regions with gradient above this percentile are protected from denoise. Lower values protect more structure. Range 0–100. Recommended: 85–90.
param.luma_denoise.enabled.explain: Enables the standalone luminance denoise stage, running on the reconstructed post-stack linear image before BGE/PCC. Addresses luminance noise already present in the reconstructed signal, ahead of chroma_denoise (which only smooths the color components). Default: off (opt-in).
param.luma_denoise.luma_guard_strength.e: Strength of the guard protecting luminance structure from over-smoothing. 0 = no protection, 1 = full protection. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.85.
param.luma_denoise.blend_amount.explain: Blend amount between original and wavelet-denoised luma. Reconstruction is additive (R_new = R + (Y_denoised - Y) etc.), not ratio-based — ratio reconstruction amplifies noise in faint/partially protected regions and produces dark pixels and chroma fringing at star edges. Range: >= 0, <= 1. Default: 0.85.
param.luma_denoise.star_protection.enabl: Enable star protection mask for luma denoise. Prevents wavelet thresholding from softening star cores and halos. Default: true.
param.luma_denoise.star_protection.thres: Sigma threshold above local background for star detection in the protection mask. Lower values detect more stars. Range > 0. Default: 6.
param.luma_denoise.star_protection.dilat: Dilation radius for the star protection mask in pixels. Expands the protected zone around detected stars. Range >= 0. Default: 8.
Enable structure protection for luma denoise. Prevents denoise from blurring fine, faint detail such as nebula structure. Default: true.
Gradient percentile threshold for structure protection. Regions with gradient above this percentile are protected from denoise. Range 0–100. Default: 90.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.enabled.expla: Enable wavelet-based luma denoise. Decomposes luma into wavelet levels and applies soft-thresholding to remove noise.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.levels.explai: Number of wavelet decomposition levels. More levels capture larger-scale noise patterns. Range >= 1. Default: 3.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.threshold_sca: Scale factor for the wavelet noise threshold. Higher values remove more luma noise. Range > 0. Default: 1.5.
param.luma_denoise.wavelet.soft_k.explai: Soft-thresholding parameter k. Controls smoothness of the threshold transition. Higher = smoother. Range > 0. Default: 1.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.enab: Enable wavelet-based chroma denoise. Decomposes chroma into wavelet levels and applies soft-thresholding to remove noise.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.leve: Number of wavelet decomposition levels. More levels capture larger-scale noise patterns. Range >= 1. Recommended: 3.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.thre: Scale factor for wavelet noise threshold. Higher values remove more color noise. Range > 0. Recommended: 1.5–2.0.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_wavelet.soft: Soft-thresholding parameter k. Controls smoothness of threshold transition. Higher values = smoother transition. Range > 0. Recommended: 1.0.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_bilateral.en: Enable bilateral filter for chroma denoise. Edge-preserving smoothing of color channels — smooths color noise while keeping color edges intact.
param.chroma_denoise.chroma_bilateral.si: Multiplier of the measured unprotected background chroma sigma used as bilateral range sigma. Recommended: 2.0.
Spatial sigma for bilateral filter. Controls the spatial extent of smoothing. Larger values smooth over larger areas. Range > 0. Recommended: 1.5–3.0.
Weight for background penalty term in the global quality score. Higher values penalize frames with uneven or elevated backgrounds more strongly. Range 0–1. Recommended: 0.4.
param.global_metrics.weights.noise.expla: Weight for noise penalty term in the global quality score. Higher values penalize noisy frames more strongly. Range 0–1. Recommended: 0.3.
param.global_metrics.weights.gradient.ex: Weight for structure/sharpness penalty term in the global quality score. Higher values favor frames with better sharpness/structure. Range 0–1. Recommended: 0.3.
param.global_metrics.clamp.explain: Clamp range for the composite global quality z-score before exponential weight mapping. Prevents extreme outliers from dominating. Recommended: [-3.0, 3.0].
param.global_metrics.adaptive_weights.ex: Auto-adjust global metric weights based on observed variance across frames. When true, weights are normalized by the inverse variance of each metric, giving less variable metrics more influence. Recommended: false (manual weights are more predictable).
param.global_metrics.weight_exponent_sca: Exponential scaling factor for global weight separation. Controls how strongly quality differences translate into weight differences via `W_f = exp(k * Q_f)`. Values > 1 increase separation (good frames get more weight), < 1 soften it. Range > 0. Recommended: 1.0.
param.astrometry.astap_bin.explain: Path to ASTAP binary (empty = system/default path).
param.astrometry.astap_data_dir.explain: Path to ASTAP data directory (empty = default path).
param.astrometry.search_radius.explain: Search radius in degrees (`180` = blind solve).
param.bge.autobge.num_sample_points.expl: Number of AutoBGE sample points. `0` lets the implementation derive a deterministic image-size-based count (~1 point per 800 downsampled pixels, clamped to 200–3000). Higher values produce denser spatial sampling but increase runtime. Recommended: `0` (auto) for most cases, `800–1500` for large images with complex gradients.
param.bge.autobge.poly_degree.explain: Degree of the first-stage polynomial fit. `2` = quadratic (captures broad gradients), `3` = cubic (captures complex asymmetric gradients). Higher degrees risk overfitting to image structure. Recommended: `2` for most datasets, `3` only for very strong asymmetric gradients.
param.bge.autobge.rbf_smooth.explain: RBF smoothing factor for the second-stage residual fit. Higher values produce a smoother background model but may underfit local gradients. Range `0.01–1.0`. Recommended: `0.1` for typical images, `0.5` for smooth gradients.
param.bge.autobge.downsample_scale.expla: Integer downscaling factor for the working image used in AutoBGE sampling and fitting. `4` = 4x downsample (16x fewer pixels). Higher values speed up computation but reduce spatial resolution of the background model. Range `1–8`. Recommended: `4` for full-resolution images, `2` for small images.
param.bge.autobge.patch_size.explain: Odd patch size used for local background sampling. Each sample point measures the background in a patch of this size. Larger patches are more robust but average over more structure. Range `3–31`. Recommended: `15`.
param.bge.autobge.patch_estimator.explai: Local background estimator for each sample patch. `median` is fast and robust for most images. `sigma_clipped_median` iteratively rejects outliers and is better for fields with many stars or cosmic rays.
param.bge.autobge.stretch_mode.explain: Working-space transform used only for AutoBGE sampling/fitting. `linear` is the conservative default because the later HyperMetric Stretch phase runs independently and BGE should preserve the additive linear-image contract. `mtf` is intended only for AutoBGE parity/experiments.
Target median for the working-space stretch (only used when `stretch_mode=mtf`). Controls the brightness of the stretched image used for sampling. Lower values sample darker background regions. Range `0.1–0.5`.
param.bge.autobge.border_margin.explain: Pixel margin excluded from sampling at the image border. Border pixels often contain stacking artifacts or vignetting. Increase for wide-field images with strong edge effects. Range `0–100`. Recommended: `10–30`.
param.bge.autobge.bright_exclusion_fract: Fraction of brightest pixels excluded from background sampling. `0.5` excludes the top 50% (conservative, good for nebula-rich fields). Lower values (`0.2–0.3`) include more pixels but risk contaminating the background model with bright structures. Range `0.1–0.8`.
param.bge.autobge.gradient_descent_max_i: Maximum iterations for the gradient-descent sample-point placement algorithm. Each iteration moves sample points toward dimmer local regions. Higher values find deeper background spots but increase runtime. Range `20–500`. Recommended: `100`.
param.bge.autobge.random_seed.explain: Random seed for deterministic sample-point generation. Same seed + same image = identical results. Change to get alternative sample placements for comparison.
param.bge.autobge.normalize_between_stag: When true, normalizes the residual image between the polynomial first stage and the RBF second stage. Prevents the RBF from re-fitting large-scale gradients already captured by the polynomial. Recommended: `true`.
param.bge.autobge.apply_guards.explain: When true, AutoBGE uses the shared outer BGE apply guards (flatness/slope check) before mutating RGB output. Prevents degradation from poor fits. Recommended: `true`.
param.bge.autobge.mono_mode.explain: Handling of mono (single-channel) images. `rgb_duplicate` copies the mono channel to R/G/B before BGE, allowing per-channel correction. `disabled` processes only the single channel. Use `rgb_duplicate` for OSC images debayered to mono.
param.bge.tile_weight_lambda_structure.e: Lambda in tile reliability weight `w_t = exp(-lambda * structure_score_t) * (1 - masked_fraction_t)`. Higher values down-weight structure-rich tiles more aggressively. Range `0.5–3.0`. Recommended: `1.0` for moderate fields, `2.0+` for dense nebulosity.
param.bge.sample_quantile.explain: Tile background quantile used to estimate robust background samples. Lower values (`0.10–0.15`) are more conservative, resistant to nebula contamination. `0.50` = median, suitable for heavily masked fields. Range `(0, 0.5]`.
param.bge.structure_thresh_percentile.ex: Structure-threshold percentile used to reject structure-rich tiles or pixels from BGE sampling. `0.80` = moderate (excludes top 20%), `0.90` = strict (excludes top 10%). Lower values preserve more samples but risk structure contamination. Range `0.5–0.95`.
param.bge.min_tiles_per_cell.explain: Minimum number of valid tiles required per BGE grid cell. Cells with fewer valid tiles trigger the `insufficient_cell_strategy`. Range `1–10`. Recommended: `3`.
param.bge.mask.star_dilate_px.explain: Star-mask dilation radius in pixels. Expands the exclusion zone around detected stars to prevent star halos from contaminating background samples. Range `0–20`. Recommended: `4–6` for typical seeing, `8–12` for wide-field with bright stars.
param.bge.mask.sat_dilate_px.explain: Saturation-mask dilation radius in pixels. Expands the exclusion zone around saturated pixels/cores. Range `0–20`. Recommended: `4–6`, increase for sensors with strong blooming.
param.bge.grid.N_g.explain: Target BGE grid density. Grid cell size `G = min(W,H) / N_g`. Higher values create finer grids for better gradient capture but require more samples per cell. Range `16–64`. Recommended: `32–36` for typical DSO images, `48+` for wide-field.
param.bge.grid.G_min_px.explain: Minimum pixel size of a BGE grid cell. Prevents cells from becoming too small on large images. Range `32–128`. Recommended: `56–64`.
param.bge.grid.G_max_fraction.explain: Upper bound for grid-cell size relative to the image extent. Prevents cells from becoming too large on small images. Range `0.1–0.5`. Recommended: `0.25`.
param.bge.grid.insufficient_cell_strateg: Fallback strategy for grid cells with too few valid samples. `discard` excludes the cell from fitting (conservative). `nearest` fills from nearest valid cell. `radius_expand` enlarges the search radius to find more samples. Recommended: `radius_expand` for border cells.
param.bge.fit.method.explain: Surface fitting method for the background model. `rbf` = Radial Basis Functions (flexible, recommended for most gradients). `poly` = robust polynomial (good for broad smooth gradients, faster). `spline` = thin-plate spline. `bicubic` = bicubic spline. `modeled_mask_mesh` = segmentation-based mesh fit for large nebulae.
param.bge.fit.irls_max_iterations.explai: Maximum IRLS (Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares) iterations. Higher values allow better convergence but increase runtime. Range `5–20`. Recommended: `10`.
param.bge.fit.irls_tolerance.explain: Convergence tolerance for IRLS. Iteration stops when the parameter change falls below this value. Range `1e-6–1e-3`. Recommended: `1e-4`.
param.bge.fit.polynomial_order.explain: Polynomial order when `bge.fit.method=poly`. `2` = quadratic (broad gradients, safe default). `3` = cubic (complex asymmetric gradients, higher overfitting risk). Recommended: `2`.
param.bge.fit.rbf_mu_factor.explain: RBF shape parameter `μ = rbf_mu_factor × G` (grid spacing). Controls the width of the basis functions. Higher values produce smoother surfaces. Range `0.5–3.0`. Recommended: `1.0–1.5`.
param.bge.fit.rbf_lambda.explain: RBF regularization parameter λ. Prevents overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. Higher values = smoother but may underfit. Range `1e-6–0.1`. Recommended: `0.01–0.1`.
param.bge.fit.rbf_epsilon.explain: Numerical stabilization epsilon for thin-plate RBF at d=0. Prevents division by zero. Range `1e-10–1.0`. Recommended: `1e-10` for thinplate, `1.0` for multiquadric.
param.bge.min_valid_sample_fraction_for_: Per-channel safety gate. If `valid_tile_samples / total_tile_samples` falls below this fraction, BGE is skipped for that channel. Prevents poor-quality correction from sparse sampling. Range `0.1–0.5`. Recommended: `0.25–0.30`.
param.bge.min_valid_samples_for_apply.ex: Absolute per-channel safety gate. If fewer than this many valid robust tile samples are available, BGE is skipped for that channel. Range `24–200`. Recommended: `96`.
param.bge.fit.robust_loss.explain: Robust loss function for IRLS fitting. `huber` = quadratic for small residuals, linear for large (moderate outlier rejection). `tukey` = completely rejects large residuals (aggressive outlier rejection). Recommended: `huber`.
param.bge.fit.huber_delta.explain: Huber loss transition parameter δ. Residuals below δ are quadratic, above δ are linear. Smaller δ rejects more outliers. Range `0.5–3.0`. Recommended: `1.5`.
param.pcc.enabled.explain: Enable/disable photometric color calibration. Matches catalog star colors to calibrate the RGB color balance of the stacked image.
param.pcc.mag_limit.explain: Faint magnitude limit for PCC catalog star matching. Higher values include fainter stars. CAUTION: for small sensors or dense star fields, mag_limit > 15 can include stars below detection threshold. Range 1–22. Recommended: 14.
param.pcc.mag_bright_limit.explain: Bright magnitude limit for PCC catalog star matching. Stars brighter than this are excluded (saturated stars give unreliable photometry). Range 0–15. Recommended: 6.
param.pcc.min_stars.explain: Minimum number of matched catalog stars required for PCC to proceed. Below this, PCC is skipped. Range >= 3. Recommended: 10.
param.pcc.sigma_clip.explain: Sigma clipping threshold for PCC outlier rejection. Stars with residuals > sigma_clip × std are rejected. Range > 0. Recommended: 2.5.
param.pcc.background_model.explain: Local sky-annulus background model for stellar photometry (`plane` recommended under gradients, fallback to `median` if plane fit fails).
param.pcc.max_condition_number.explain: Upper bound for PCC matrix condition number; rejects numerically unstable solutions.
param.pcc.max_residual_rms.explain: Upper bound for robust fit residual RMS; rejects noisy/unstable PCC fits.
param.pcc.radii_mode.explain: Radius handling mode. `auto_fwhm` derives aperture/annulus radii from seeing FWHM using the multipliers below.
param.pcc.apply_attenuation.explain: Enables adaptive attenuation during PCC matrix application (helps in deep shadows/highlights).
param.pcc.background_neutralization_mode: Controls the post-PCC background neutralization step. `always` forces neutral background offsets, `off` disables the step, and `auto` attenuates or skips it when the measured "background" looks nebulosity-dominated rather than truly neutral sky.
param.pcc.chroma_strength.explain: Global strength factor for PCC chroma correction during apply.
param.pcc.k_max.explain: Upper bound for linear PCC apply strength (limits over-correction in bright structures).
param.runtime_limits.parallel_workers.ex: Max worker threads for tile-heavy phases.
param.runtime_limits.memory_budget.expla: Memory cap that can reduce effective worker parallelism (especially for OSC).
param.runtime_limits.hard_abort_hours.ex: Hard upper runtime limit in hours.
param.runtime_limits.acceleration_backen: GPU acceleration backend selection for PREWARP and FORWARD_DRIZZLE phases.
param.calibration.bias_use_master.explai: Use prebuilt master calibration files instead of stacking directories.
param.calibration.dark_use_master.explai: Use prebuilt master calibration files instead of stacking directories.
param.calibration.flat_use_master.explai: Use prebuilt master calibration files instead of stacking directories.
param.calibration.dark_match_use_temp.ex: When `dark_match_use_temp=true`, sensor temperature is also considered for dark matching.
param.calibration.dark_match_temp_tolera: When `dark_match_use_temp=true`, sensor temperature is also considered for dark matching.
param.calibration.bias_master.explain: Paths to precomputed master calibration files.
param.calibration.dark_master.explain: Paths to precomputed master calibration files.
param.calibration.flat_master.explain: Paths to precomputed master calibration files.
param.registration.reject_scale_min.expl: Allowed similarity scale range. Warps outside `[reject_scale_min, reject_scale_max]` or with negative determinant (reflection) are rejected.
param.registration.reject_scale_max.expl: Allowed similarity scale range. Warps outside `[reject_scale_min, reject_scale_max]` or with negative determinant (reflection) are rejected.
param.pcc.aperture_radius_px.explain: Aperture/annulus geometry for star photometry. `aperture_radius_px` is the photometric aperture radius, `annulus_inner_px` and `annulus_outer_px` define the sky annulus for local background estimation. Used when `radii_mode=fixed`.
param.pcc.annulus_inner_px.explain: Aperture/annulus geometry for star photometry. `aperture_radius_px` is the photometric aperture radius, `annulus_inner_px` and `annulus_outer_px` define the sky annulus for local background estimation. Used when `radii_mode=fixed`.
param.pcc.annulus_outer_px.explain: Aperture/annulus geometry for star photometry. `aperture_radius_px` is the photometric aperture radius, `annulus_inner_px` and `annulus_outer_px` define the sky annulus for local background estimation. Used when `radii_mode=fixed`.
param.bge.autotune.max_evals.explain: hard cap for tested candidates (minimum `1`, default `24`)
param.bge.autotune.alpha_flatness.explai: objective weight for flatness term (minimum `0`, default `0.25`)
param.bge.autotune.beta_roughness.explai: objective weight for roughness term (minimum `0`, default `0.10`)
param.hypermetric_stretch.enabled.explai: enables VeraLux HyperMetric Stretch after PCC.
param.hypermetric_stretch.require_succes: requires successful PCC artifacts before HMS.
param.hypermetric_stretch.mode.explain: `ready_to_use` final output mode or `scientific` controlled stretch mode.
param.hypermetric_stretch.color_cast_cor: Pulls the green channel back towards the mean of red and blue where it exceeds it (Siril SCNR average neutral), measured above the per-channel sky level so the sky level is kept. The strength is chosen automatically from the object pixels. Off by default. Applied to the stretched RGB after HMS, because HMS itself can raise the green share.
Cap for the automatic strength. 1.0 allows a full pull-back; lower values leave part of the green. Range: above 0 to 1; default: 1.0.
The strength is chosen so that the median G/((R+B)/2) on the object pixels reaches this value. 1.0 is neutral; values slightly above 1 keep some green. Range: above 0.5 to 1.5; default: 1.0.
Protection for genuinely green or teal objects (e.g. OIII emission): if the measured ratio is already at or below this value the image is not changed. Range: 1 to 2; default: 1.02.
Object pixels are those whose blurred luminance is more than this many sky sigmas above the sky; the brightest 1 % (stars) are excluded from the measurement. Range: above 0 to 50; default: 3.

The object pixels are split into this many equal-count brightness classes. The correction strength is chosen per class (target and protection threshold apply per class) and interpolated over the pixel brightness, so a cast that differs between faint regions and a bright core is corrected in both without overcorrecting either. 1 gives a single global strength. Range: 1 to 32; default: 8.

Adds a constant to G so that the sky level of G equals the mean of the R and B sky levels. The excess correction leaves the sky level alone, so without this a slightly magenta or green sky stays tinted and faint areas keep its tint in the displayed image. Skipped when the offset would exceed 25 % of the R/B sky level (implausible sky measurement). Default: off.
param.hypermetric_stretch.highlight_ceil: trades bounded highlight clipping for more contrast; does not brighten the dark/mid-tone body (that's target_bg's job).
